races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Virtue Patience
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who's 3lb lower than his close C&D effort in January and better on Polytrack than turf
runners_data.spotlight: Better record on Polytrack than turf and the handicapper's given him every chance, with him now 3lb lower than when not beaten far as favourite over C&D in January; looks set to go well back on the AW.

runners_data.name: Pitney
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type but trainer is 0/13 in last 14 days and needs significant improvement to break losing run
runners_data.spotlight: Rated much higher when joining this yard in autumn 2024; remained consistent enough off a sliding mark during the winter but needs more if he's to snap the losing run.

runners_data.name: Searchingtheblues
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with strong Tapeta form and 5lb claiming jockey, won on Polytrack previously
runners_data.spotlight: Won her first two as a 2yo and entered handicaps on an unrealistic mark; best efforts of late have come on Tapeta but she's won on Polytrack and has been offering more of late; capable at this level.

runners_data.name: Amber Honey
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but 54 days since last run and hard to predict after stable switch from Ed Dunlop
runners_data.spotlight: Hold-up filly whose win for Ed Dunlop, from whom she was picked up in April for 7,500gns, came on Tapeta; become hard to predict and there's no sign of the usual headgear back from a short break.

runners_data.name: Mbappe
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with C&D course form but 117 days off and cheekpieces retained after disappointing last effort
runners_data.spotlight: Two turf wins here and two Polytrack victories at Kempton, latterly off 3lb lower in January; below-par in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when last seen four months ago (won fresh before) but remains on a workable mark.

runners_data.name: Play Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up type reunited with regular partner Murphy but 5lb worse off with Buy The Dip since their last meeting
runners_data.spotlight: Epsom winner last August for regular partner Donagh Murphy off a 5lb lower mark; fair comeback over C&D behind Buy The Dip in April (6lb better off today) but didn't build on that back on turf a fortnight ago.

runners_data.name: Volto Di Medusa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to AW after three poor turf efforts, positive jockey booking with Rossa Ryan
runners_data.spotlight: Tapeta win last summer came off this mark and the booking of Rossa Ryan is a positive as he returns to the AW after three ordinary efforts on turf; not always looked straightforward and interesting to see whether support comes this time.

runners_data.name: Buy The Dip
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner suited by this switchback track with C&D win in April, though found life tougher subsequently
runners_data.spotlight: Well suited by switchback tracks and took advantage of a handy mark when winning on his C&D comeback in April; found life tougher off his revised mark in better company here last time but this is more his speed back down 2lb.

runners_data.name: Secret Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran with three wins earlier this year including two at this course but now up in weights
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a revival for James Owen and this yard earlier in the year, with three wins, including two round here; up in the weights now, though, and finished well behind a couple of these over C&D a month ago; needs more from somewhere.

runners_data.name: Showmedemoney
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner returning to winning blinkers but lacks usual tongue-tie for this key pace role
runners_data.spotlight: Goes back to the blinkers worn for both Newcastle wins, latterly off 3lb lower, for Iain Jardine in the winter but again no sign of the usual tongue-tie; big price and well held for his new yard on turf a few weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Victory Sound
runners_data.note: Hold-up type on sliding handicap mark after struggling as 3-year-old, big outsider with 5lb claimer
runners_data.spotlight: Useful 2yo for Charles Hills who struggled badly during a limited campaign last season; handicapper quick to ease off and it wouldn't be the biggest shock were he to pop up for a yard also responsible for Searchingtheblues.

runners_data.name: Dios De La Guerra
runners_data.note: Prominent style but regressive maiden after 181 days off, relies entirely on first-time headgear making difference
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive maiden who had breaks between his three handicaps runs last year (beaten a long way each time); the first-time headgear will need to be a difference maker back from six months off.

races.paceDynamic: Showmedemoney and Dios De La Guerra are the only pace angles, with Showmedemoney the sole confirmed front runner likely to get an uncontested lead in his blinkers. With 10 hold-up horses and minimal early pace pressure, this sets up a crawling tempo where the leaders can dictate terms completely. The lack of pace competition means Showmedemoney can coast through steady fractions before the field bunches up in a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can sit close to the pace, as hold-up horses will face a wall of traffic when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Showmedemoney gets easy early fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can dictate completely soft fractions before finding another gear when challenged, while the massed hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic. Front runners and prominent racers who can track the leader get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of pace creates a bunched field turning for home
scenarios.body: Ten hold-up horses converge simultaneously creating a wall of traffic, allowing only those with the clearest runs or best turn of foot to emerge. The most experienced hold-up horses with tactical jockeys find the gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys recognize the pace scenario and move their hold-up horses closer
scenarios.body: Smart tactical riding sees key hold-up horses positioned more prominently to avoid the inevitable traffic, creating a more competitive pace scenario. Those with natural pace who can adapt their running style benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Showmedemoney stops quickly after dictating slow fractions
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader pays for easy fractions and comes back to the field dramatically in the final furlong. Raw finishing speed from the back becomes crucial as the race becomes a pure sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Showmedemoney getting easy lead fractions - if uncontested he can dictate terms completely and prove very hard to peg back
Traffic problems at the two-furlong pole with ten hold-up horses converging simultaneously from the back of the field
Buy The Dip and Play Me meeting again with different weight terms after their C&D encounter in April
Virtue Patience and Mbappe both returning to Polytrack after mixed recent form but with proven course credentials
First-time headgear on Dios De La Guerra after long absence - trainer Simon Dow is 1/2 in last 14 days

runners_data.name: Southbank
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong C&D form who was unlucky last time and looks well-handicapped for this tactical setup.
runners_data.spotlight: Nothing wrong with his C&D second a month ago and was unlucky back on turf last time (same Bath handicap he won last season), when hitting plenty of traffic; will rightly be popular.

runners_data.name: Jackson Street
runners_data.note: Hold-up type having first sprint run in a year with poor recent trainer form and awkward wide draw to overcome.
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive gelding who's having his first run in a sprint since this time last year and is drawn widest; well held back from a break on turf here a fortnight ago (7f) but will be happier back on Polytrack should they go hard in front.

runners_data.name: Chasing Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with starting stall issues who unseated last time when rearing, making him very risky.
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who's had his moments at the start and often pulled hard; reared as the stalls opened on his turf comeback and unseated, so can only be considered risky in first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: Tomarlo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 27-day break for new connections after struggling early in the year.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who struggled in three runs early in the year for Barry Brennan; well backed for his new yard on Tapeta early last month, when things didn't pan out his way, and is on an attractive mark currently; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Walking On Clouds
runners_data.note: Hold-up type on competitive mark who finished close to Southbank over C&D last time and rates each-way value.
runners_data.spotlight: Missed a chunk of last year and has slid to a competitive mark for his current yard; just behind Southbank over C&D a month ago and is one to consider back in headgear (second-time blinkers).

runners_data.name: Ashford Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trying sprints for just the second time despite being keen-going, with 5lb claimer aboard.
runners_data.spotlight: Winner here early in the year who's been held a few times since; running in a sprint for just the second time and, for all that she's a keen-goer, whether she'll have the required toe round here is the question.

runners_data.name: Griselda
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with finishing problems trying first-time visor after regressive form for current connections.
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive and inconsistent for this yard, and is tried in a first-time visor instead of cheekpieces tonight; needs to bounce back from a couple of ordinary efforts on turf.

runners_data.name: Top Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with multiple headgear changes who was fourth behind some of these over C&D previously.
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who missed a chunk of his career; tried in three forms of headgear this year, including when fourth behind two of these over C&D a month ago, and is given another try without today.

runners_data.name: Poetic Jack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who gets tactical advantage as lone pace-setter but pulled hard when favourite here last time.
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled hard when well behind three of these as favourite over C&D a month ago; another poor one on turf since tempers enthusiasm.

runners_data.name: Dreamcrafter
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 284-day absence with minimal form to recommend after lengthy layoff.
runners_data.spotlight: Achieved little in a handful of starts last year (5f-7f) and is hard to fancy returning from a lengthy absence.

races.paceDynamic: Poetic Jack is the sole identified pace-setter and should lead from the outset, with no other horses showing prominent tendencies to challenge early. This creates a remarkably soft lead scenario where Poetic Jack can dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. With nine hold-up horses positioned behind him, the race sets up as a classic front-runner's dream on this 6f trip. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours Poetic Jack's prominent style, giving him every chance to steal a march on the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Jack gets an easy lead and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: He can dictate fractions and kick clear when the field comes after him late. The soft pace plays directly into his hands against nine hold-up horses who need something to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The better-rated hold-up horses can time their runs perfectly and overwhelm a tiring leader. Quality tells when they all converge together in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits Outcasts
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys panic about the slow pace and make premature moves
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with horses getting in each other's way turning for home. Lesser lights can slip through gaps while favourites get trapped.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Jack pulls too hard again or doesn't handle the surface
scenarios.body: He empties out before the finish line despite his tactical advantage. The first wave of challengers inherit a perfect stalking trip and take over smoothly.

watchPoints.text: Poetic Jack could pull hard again like last time over C&D, which would negate his tactical advantage completely.
Chasing Gold reared and unseated at the stalls last time so any antics at the start make him unbackable.
Jackson Street is drawn in stall 10 and will need luck from the wide berth in his first sprint for twelve months.
The pace could become crawling with only one front-runner, potentially setting up a blanket finish that favours pure class.
Southbank hit trouble last time on turf and has solid C&D form that makes him the main danger to the leader.

runners_data.name: Starship Trooper
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who was close to Parisian Scholar at Kempton, but 61 days off the track raises fitness questions
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown ability and was only just behind Parisian Scholar when fourth of five on handicap debut at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) in April; might not come into his own until contesting a strongly run race in a bigger field, though.

runners_data.name: Astrological
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid Wolverhampton form but untested against this quality and on this surface
runners_data.spotlight: Both starts at Wolverhampton (9.5f, Tapeta), finishing second of five on debut in March before landing odds of 1-2 the following month; that latest form hasn't worked out, but he remains unexposed and the longer trip shouldn't be an issue on this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Charles Darnay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won over this distance at Kempton but faces tactical nightmare with lack of pace in this race
runners_data.spotlight: Built on earlier promise upped in trip when off the mark in a Kempton maiden (1m4f, Polytrack) in March; off three months and this easier track may not be ideal, but the three immediately behind him at Kempton have all won since; respected on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Parisian Scholar
runners_data.note: Front-runner with three wins at this trip last autumn, returns after 18 days and gets tactical advantage in small field
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who landed three 1m handicaps last autumn, the last two at Newcastle (Tapeta); twice placed off 2lb higher at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) earlier this year, but may be vulnerable to an improver; visor replaces cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Wardlaw
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning quickly after gelding operation, lightweight but poor recent form is concerning
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth of 13 behind Talk Of New York on his third start at Kempton (1m, Polytrack) last October, but having been gelded he looked one-paced when fifth of seven on handicap/turf debut at Windsor (11.4f, good) a fortnight ago; needs to improve for the cheekpieces, but that is possible.

races.paceDynamic: Parisian Scholar will dictate from the front with his confirmed leading style, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field. Starship Trooper and Astrological are the only prominent racers who might track him, but neither shows aggressive early pace. With just five runners and minimal early pressure, Parisian Scholar can set sustainable fractions before the others need to make their moves turning for home. This shape clearly favors front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as late-running Charles Darnay faces a significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Parisian Scholar gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back up the straight. Front-runners with tactical speed hold all the cards in small fields like this.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Starship Trooper and Astrological both track Parisian Scholar closely from the start
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more honest and one of the prominent runners can strike late. Their superior ratings and fitness edge could tell in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Charles Darnay Comeback
scenarios.trigger: If the front trio go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: Charles Darnay's hold-up style becomes an asset as he picks up the pieces from the back. His proven stamina at this trip could be decisive if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wardlaw Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Wardlaw shows improved form since gelding and gets a perfect tracking position
scenarios.body: His prominent style allows him to sit handy while others do the donkey work. The weight advantage and recent run could combine for an upset.

watchPoints.text: Charles Darnay needs a strong pace to set up his finishing kick but may get stranded at the back if Parisian Scholar gets loose
Starship Trooper's 61-day layoff could impact his ability to match the pace set by the sharper Parisian Scholar
Astrological drops in class from recent Wolverhampton wins and Luke Catton's 3-pound claim provides useful weight relief
Wardlaw showed gelding operation hasn't sparked immediate improvement when fifth last time at Kempton
Parisian Scholar's quick return after 18 days suggests connections are confident in his current condition
